en.name: Arm raises
en.subtitle: Follow along · Primary 1–3
steps: Stand facing the camera with your arms by your sides.
Slowly lift both arms out to shoulder height.
Bring them back down. That is one movement.
en.focus: Follow your teacher and move at your own pace.

zh-Hant.name: 手臂平舉
zh-Hant.subtitle: 跟著做 · 小一至小三
steps: 面向鏡頭站立，雙手放在身旁。
慢慢向兩側抬起雙手，與肩膀同高。
把雙手放下，完成一次動作。
zh-Hant.focus: 跟著老師，以自己的速度活動。
